statement: HHD's compatible motion scheduler and virtualgamepad's nominal 4 ms timestamp do not prove that every physical DualSense emits input at 250 Hz or that rumble writes have identical resend cadence on UHID, USB and BT.

applicability.revision: public Steam rules 22ec85e, systemd ede1e57, kernel 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b or virtualgamepad 8f60dcc; host not inspected
applicability.scope: HHD source runtime choices, Linux/SDL sensor parser; the actual physical device cadence is not measured. #166 time-base lab required.
